responsibility: Defines the FR-V target command-line options and their bindings to backend variables and masks. It describes -mcpu, feature toggles for media, packing, conditional execution, floating-point, FDPIC, TLS, scheduler lookahead, branch cost, debug switches, and related ABI/code-generation controls, and ties the -mcpu option to the frv_cpu_t enum so option parsing can configure the FR-V backend consistently.
same_name_distinction: Target option definition file for FR-V: unlike frv.cc, frv.h, and frv.md, it does not implement backend logic or instruction patterns, but declaratively defines -m options, their masks/variables, and the -mcpu enum bindings that configure the rest of the FR-V backend.
